{
  "subtype": "focus_inference",
  "implied_focus": "The nature and quality of each goal's improvement intervention -- i.e., characterizing what kind of change each goal represents and how well-specified/measurable it is.",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "intervention_type", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Classifies the kind of improvement lever each goal pursues -- a core facet of characterizing the intervention behind a goal."},
    {"name": "scope_of_change", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Captures breadth/reach of the intervention (company-wide vs team), a coherent facet of the same focus."},
    {"name": "time_horizon", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Temporal dimension of the goal/intervention; sensible facet for prioritizing attention."},
    {"name": "measurement_approach", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "How the goal is measured -- ties directly to whether a goal is trackable, part of characterizing worth-of-attention."},
    {"name": "metric_category_alignment", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Quality/consistency flag on whether metric matches category; contributes to assessing goal rigor, adjacent to the focus."},
    {"name": "baseline_state_specified", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Measurability/completeness flag indicating whether progress can be judged -- supports the 'worth attention' quality angle."},
    {"name": "category_specific_lever", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Finer-grained lever within category; a deeper facet of intervention characterization, though partially overlaps intervention_type."}
  ],
  "focus_coherence": 0.82,
  "structure_quality": 0.78,
  "focus_actionability": 0.8,
  "rationale": "The columns collectively centre on a coherent inferred focus: characterizing each goal's improvement intervention along several facets (type, scope, time horizon, measurement) plus data-quality/specification flags (metric-category alignment, baseline specified). This is not a scattered grab-bag; the facets are complementary and cohere around 'what kind of change is this goal and is it well-specified/measurable.' Structure is sound and multi-faceted at a useful granularity, mixing categorical typologies with binary rigor flags, giving a genuine analytical decomposition rather than a single restatement. There is mild redundancy between intervention_type and category_specific_lever, and the two boolean flags lean toward a data-quality sub-theme that is slightly distinct from the intervention-characterization theme, which prevents top marks on coherence. The implied focus is actionable: an analyst can prioritize goals by scope, horizon, measurement rigor, and baseline availability to decide 'what's worth attention.' None of the columns are mechanical/generic (no token counts or bare sentiment), so the claim is substantively realised."
}
